rationale.overall: A better matches the REF’s dual-form physical read: a heavy dark bar plus a clearly present frosted loop with convincing orange under-glow and soft depth.
rationale.material: A’s loop shows stronger thickness, ribbing, and light wrap, and the block’s volume and glow spill read closer to the REF’s translucency and shading than B’s flatter, fainter secondary form.
rationale.silhouette: A keeps a clearer bar-plus-loop outline like the REF, while B’s loop collapses toward a faint C/ring and leaves mostly the diagonal bar.
rationale.smallsize: At 32 and 16 both reduce to the same strong dark-diagonal-plus-orange signal on the split ground, so neither pulls ahead.
